title: FHIR logical models
summary: The WHO SMART Trust PHW logical models (DVCMin and its PreQual and vaccine-details variants) as FHIR R5 StructureDefinitions, fetched at a pinned commit by fetch-lms, and the R5 primitive patterns. lm-derive reads them.
validatorNotApplicable: FHIR R5 StructureDefinitions compiled by SUSHI from smart-trust-phw at the commit models/fhir/SOURCE.yaml pins, and the R5 primitive regexes extracted from hl7.fhir.r5.core; their schema is FHIR R5 itself (external-schemas/hl7-fhir-r5), so a validator for them is a FHIR validator, not a Zod schema here. None runs today: lm-derive reads only kind=logical definitions, skips nested elements, maps an unknown type to a string and only warns on an invariant it cannot translate, and `lm_derive.py --check` sees a changed input only through its outputs.
